# Independent static carrier factory scope

A generic class extends a generic base and declares static factories with a
separate method formal. The complete invariant Seed<T> input and Factory<T>
result share only that method scope. An integer and two fixed Context references
add no type-variable binding. The short overload forwards the original values
and a null tail to the full overload.

Source and SDK layouts compile every emitted unit and compare complete original
class/method/Code/access/Signature/Exceptions/MethodParameters facts. Four frozen
routes run 112 fresh JVM cases twice, preserving opaque factory results, nulls,
context aliases, extreme integers, callbacks, partial effects and exact checked,
runtime and Error identity. A separately compiled generic seed implementation
checks that bridge and element reads remain deferred until the frozen caller
requests them. Sixteen wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls
exercise the observer and binding boundary. Only authored fixtures execute.
